fixed_math.U_gradient: G[i,j]=sum U[a,i]*grad_X[j] N[a], physical U in mm; subtraction of cell-constant U leaves derivatives unchanged
fixed_math.incident_weight: Vc/10; Vc=sum immutable accepted positive4Q physical weights; same single weight per incident native cell-node
fixed_math.missing_nodes: mass0 gives explicit valid0 and zero tensor slots; reached failures cannot be hidden as mass0
fixed_math.coverage: Actual mass>0 exactly equals supplied oldvalid, torch.equal; no validity rewrite
